conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 7. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.9 | 4.5 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 6.1 | 3.0 | 700 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
